title: Build a 4-Lane Rhythm Game in Scratch
prerequisites: Open Scratch and save a project
Drag, connect, and edit Scratch blocks
objectives: Build and test one complete rhythm-game lane before duplicating it.
Use variables, loops, conditions, operators, keyboard input, and the Music extension in a working game.
Duplicate a tested sprite pattern and change only the lane position and control key.
evidence: Saved .sb3 project with four working lanes

requirements.device: Computer or Chromebook with a keyboard
requirements.account: No account required when students use File > Save to your computer
requirements.internet: Required for Scratch online and the published guide
requirements.storage: Guide progress remains in this browser and device
requirements.offline: Print the guide before class and use Scratch Desktop. Students submit the saved .sb3 file.

accessibility: Text labels accompany all category colors
formalAssessment: Use separate teacher directions and a rubric if the project receives a formal grade.
